guidance: We remain confident in the growth potential across our businesses, supported by continued ARPU expansion in mobility, deeper penetration of homes, and the increasing scale of our B2B portfolio.
capex: Capex for the quarter was about Rs.12,500 Crores, leading to a robust operating free cash flow, which is EBITDAaL minus capex, of over Rs.19,000 Crores.
Capex for the quarter was Rs.7,430 Crores.
risks: Cost discipline remains core to how we operate and as cost pressures build, funding the growth will depend on how much waste we take out of the system.
These initiatives are helping us mitigate inflationary pressures arising from ongoing geopolitical headwinds.
focus: Our diversified and resilient portfolio continues to deliver strongly, and I will explain that.
Targeting customer cohorts with stronger engagement and retention.
This includes sustained investments in network quality, reliability, and resilience, with a clear focus on delivering a world- class B2B network.
